node.label: Alexander disease type II
node.definition: Alexander disease type II (AxD type II) is an astrogliopathy and a form of Alexander disease (AxD) characterized by ataxia, bulbar symptoms, spastic paraparesis, palatal myoclonus, and autonomic symptoms.

evidence.snippet: Disease-causing germline mutation(s) (gain of function) in (Assessed) — glial fibrillary acidic protein
GFAP is annotated as disease gene of ORPHA:363722 (HPO genes_to_phenotype, Orphanet-derived)
